query:
INSERT INTO customs_travel (citizen_id, passport_number, last_arrival, arrival_port, frequent_traveller)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id) DO UPDATE SET
              passport_number = EXCLUDED.passport_number,
              last_arrival = EXCLUDED.last_arrival,
              arrival_port = EXCLUDED.arrival_port,
              frequent_traveller = EXCLUDED.frequent_traveller
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
